title: Bound LSP messages, recursive results, diagnostics queues, and retained UI state
description:
## Finding

Even beyond frame buffering, parsed LSP values are recursively flattened and copied with no count/depth/string limits. Symbol collection recursively walks server-controlled `children` and can stack overflow. Diagnostics are sent over an unbounded channel and retained per root/file without caps; result vectors, hover markdown, signatures, actions, paths, codes, and messages are unbounded. A server can repeatedly publish large unique files faster than the UI drains.

## Evidence

* `crates/thegn-svc/src/lsp/mod.rs:390-444` recursively collects symbols with no depth/node bound.
* Parsers at `445-570` clone arbitrary server strings/arrays.
* `LspSupervisor::from_config` creates an unbounded std mpsc diagnostics channel.
* `LspDiagnostics::apply` retains unlimited roots/files/items/string bytes.
* The shared frame limit is 64 MiB per message, not an aggregate queue/state budget.

## Impact

A buggy or compromised language server can cause stack overflow, unbounded memory growth, render latency, and event-loop starvation while remaining protocol-valid.

## Acceptance criteria

* Define per-message, JSON depth, collection count, string/markdown/path, diagnostics-per-file, files-per-root, roots, queue, and total retained-byte caps.
* Parse/flatten iteratively with deterministic truncation/error metadata.
* Replace unbounded delivery with bounded latest-per-document coalescing and generation sequencing.
* Apply work budgets per loop/frame so LSP floods cannot starve terminal/control work.
* Sanitize control/terminal characters before UI use while preserving source data safely.
* Expose dropped/truncated/stale health.
* Add deep symbols, huge arrays/strings, unique-file floods, repeated replacements/clears, slow consumer, multi-root fairness, exact limits, and recovery tests.

## Dependencies

Blocked by <issue id="4e4f78e2-a342-4157-810c-73468cff3a29" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-310/bound-and-linearize-framed-protocol-decoding-under-hostile-streams">THE-310</issue> for bounded linear framing. Related to <issue id="d64bc546-3454-4754-9c8e-ba3c321401a7" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-161/bound-plugin-output-resident-queues-stderr-framing-and-retained">THE-161</issue>, <issue id="f4c28940-ce66-43a1-8cef-75e04775f896" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-184/fetch-observe-panels-concurrently-with-bounded-queues-deadlines-and">THE-184</issue>, <issue id="a7d8a0fa-0c44-41e1-86fd-7cae85d11477" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-205/extract-typed-actors-and-damage-contracts-from-the-monolithic">THE-205</issue>, and <issue id="aad09961-0e12-4754-9a7a-35ffad4d0076" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-276/enforce-one-bounded-control-frame-per-websocket-message-and-eliminate">THE-276</issue>.

## September 15 performance project cross-reference

Project: [Interactive Performance & Runtime Fairness](<https://linear.app/blakeashley/project/interactive-performance-and-runtime-fairness-74506d6dff14>). [Full review, evidence correction and execution index](<https://linear.app/blakeashley/document/september-15-performance-review-evidence-coverage-and-execution-index-2822509847d3>).

The September 15 host review confirms the diagnostics receiver drains with while try_recv and applies all available publications before merging into the visible model. <issue id="9f596b1c-f4eb-45be-8ea3-6b2b1f33a973" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-658/coalesce-lsp-diagnostics-within-byte-bounds-and-budget-host">THE-658</issue> is a new child of this issue covering bounded diagnostics delivery and budgeted host application. It must preserve empty-publication clears, workspace/document/server generation identity, bounded unique keys and bytes, explicit overload health and quiet-root/input fairness.

Parser recursion/depth, general message/string limits, sanitization and broader retained-state bounds remain on this parent. <issue id="905ea988-4f2a-4c46-a365-4c000476d238" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-657/inventory-host-event-ingress-and-define-per-source-plus-aggregate">THE-657</issue> supplies the shared per-source plus aggregate drain contract; this child is not blocked on the entire <issue id="a7d8a0fa-0c44-41e1-86fd-7cae85d11477" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-205/extract-typed-actors-and-damage-contracts-from-the-monolithic">THE-205</issue> extraction.

### Scoped follow-through

* [THE-657: Inventory host event ingress and define per-source plus aggregate drain budgets](<https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-657/inventory-host-event-ingress-and-define-per-source-plus-aggregate>)
* [THE-658: Coalesce LSP diagnostics within byte bounds and budget host application work](<https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-658/coalesce-lsp-diagnostics-within-byte-bounds-and-budget-host>)

This update records planning and source evidence only. No implementation, benchmark run, status transition, assignment change or inherited approval/landing completion is claimed.
